sn12.23:2.1: Elsewhere _saupanisa_ is used of the seven path factors as “vital conditions” for right immersion ([sn45.28:1.2](), [mn117:2.1]()). It functions in Pali as an contraction of _upanissaya_ (“depend on”). | It is not clear if _upanisā_ is the same as the Sanskrit _upaniṣad_, for which the original sense is “correspondence, equivalence”, referring to the secret links between things (Śatapatha Brāhmaṇa 10.4.5.1; Bṛhadāraṇyaka Upaniṣad 3.9.26, 4.2.1; Chāndogya Upaniṣad 3.11.3, 8.8.4; Taittirīya Upaniṣad 1.11.4, 2.9.1). These are explained in the esoteric teachings that themselves came to be known as Upaniṣads. Pali _upanisā_ is also found in the unrelated sense “sitting close” to a teacher ([an3.67:6.7]()).
